character.description: Sena, blue-black bob, pale high-collar jacket with exactly two brass chest clasps, navy wide trousers, low brown shoes, record board at right hip. Preserve reference proportions and detailed rendering.

idle.action: A seamless subtle breathing and blink cycle. Start relaxed with eyes open, gently inhale, close eyelids briefly at middle, reopen, gently exhale, return to starting relaxed pose. Feet fixed, hands down; preserve face and outfit exactly.

victory.action: Restrained victory with clear in-between poses: look slightly down at board, lift gaze, start bending right elbow, lift a small closed fist to lower chest, settle with faint satisfied smile, hold final pose. Left arm down, feet fixed, no effects. Consistent anatomy and outfit.

style: crisp pixel art, flat limited palette, no antialiasing
